summary: The reviewed commits connect the original Calc header/footer commands and content variants to typed EditEngine and page-style owners.
findings: The focused cases establish menu and toolbar placement, first-page sharing and reset behavior, decoded file fields, source rich formatting, nested style transactions, and native ODS and XLSX round trips.
residual_risks: Browser Text Attributes exposes the common font, color and position controls. Per-region native EditView undo and the other character options remain follow-up work.
